name: Prifardd Eluned

intro.text: Every year someone thinks the eisteddfod chair is theirs. Every year I disagree. Show me what you've got, and do it with feeling.

win: That deserves a chair. A small one. Come and sit.
after: The chair and the crown are the eisteddfod's two great prizes, for strict-metre poetry and free verse. A poet who has won one is a prifardd, a chief bard. Y Wladfa's eisteddfod awards both, as in Wales.
